note: WP-4 unit side (mutate-multi.js list key 'wp4-unit', proof null: jest --runTestsByPath the named suite under the proof lock, no database). Mocked-Prisma suites are not certification evidence (plan section 1.4): these entries only show that the unit gate also turns red beside the live catch. They run on the tree the live list runs on (HEAD, or the HR-C1 fix tree: none of these suites is rewritten by the HR-C1 fix except ipc-allocation-impact.test.js, whose variation cases :593-866 and :1060-1087 the fix leaves alone, HRC1-FIX-PLAN.md s7). Each entry's tests are the titles that must fail; every title was checked to exist in its suite at HEAD (mutsyntax-wp4.js). The unmutated suites must pass first (WP4-RUN-PLAN.md section 7.4). Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-OPEN,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-OPEN would also run M-OPENa and M-OPENb; M-LOCK also M-LOCKa and M-LOCKb; M-RET also every M-RET-x), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
